主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced a reset dividend rate on its Series 25 Preference Shares, calculated as 2.30% over the annual yield on three-month Government of Canada treasury bills. The announcement was made on June 3, 2019. Additionally, the company announced a quarterly dividend rate of 1.00494% (3.987% annualized) for the period July 1, 2019 to September 30, 2019, with a dividend of $0.251235 per share payable on September 30, 2019. The company is a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$365 billion in assets under management. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Brookfield Asset Management Inc. (BAM).
